name: Burewala
sourceReview: The official Municipal Committee Burewala basemap, published through Punjab’s municipal GIS program, is local map evidence and explicitly includes parcel boundaries. It is a static PDF rather than an anonymous parcel API. Punjab PLRA/PULSE public infrastructure was also inspected; detailed parcel access is login/token-gated or otherwise did not expose a safe Burewala feature response.

queryReview.englishDiscovery: Completed; official PMDFC Burewala GIS listing, municipal basemap, PLRA, and PULSE sources found.
queryReview.localLanguageDiscovery: Completed in Urdu; official Punjab land-record and municipal-map results found, but no anonymous parcel-feature endpoint.
queryReview.geometry: No machine-readable parcel geometry returned; no GeoJSON retained.

requestOutcomes: The official municipal basemap PDF returned HTTP 200 and documents parcel boundaries. PULSE returned HTTP 200; its current JavaScript identified the official ArcGIS host, while the public page says complete parcel details require login. The public GPC parcel service returned ArcGIS 499 Token Required. PLRA/Jamabandi pages returned HTTP 200 but exposed interactive/service workflows rather than anonymous parcel geometry. PMDFC direct GET timed out; its Burewala listing was corroborated by first-party search discovery.
scopeLimits: The PDF is municipal cartography, not a queryable cadastral feature layer.
No native parcel identity, CRS, or full parcel polygon was verified, so no sample GeoJSON was written.
A token requirement, login wall, timeout, or lack of public API is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, legal-description, or value fields were requested or retained.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter review.
uncertainty: The local map evidence supports a municipal mapping custodian but not open cadastral API integration or complete parcel coverage. No claim is made about parcel absence, ownership, title, tax records, or completeness of PLRA/PULSE/internal datasets.
